name: glob_files
description: Find files in the workspace whose relative paths match a glob pattern. Supports * (single segment), ** (any depth), ? (single char), and {a,b} alternation. Returns matching paths sorted alphabetically.

detailed: Finds files matching a glob pattern in the workspace.

whimsical: {source} is casting a net for files

detailed: tool {participantRole} is matching files against a glob pattern

pattern.description: Glob pattern matched against workspace-relative paths, e.g. "*.ts" or "**/*.md".
